pages.title: Floor guide
pages.content: Three floors, seven rooms: guitars, basses and accessories on the ground floor; pianos, keys and strings on the first; band and orchestra, drums, three sound booths and the workbench on the second.

pages.title: Trial booth
pages.content: Reserve one of three private sound booths for 45 minutes, free. Bookable Tuesday to Sunday between 11:30 and 19:15.

pages.title: Care & repair
pages.content: Setups, restrings, pad and cork checks and home piano tuning from our second-floor workbench. Your first setup check is free within 90 days of purchase.

pages.title: Rentals
pages.content: Band-instrument rental from $29 / month. Rent paid counts toward purchase within 12 months.

pages.title: Staff
pages.content: Seven specialists across three floors, led by founder Mara Ellison.

pages.title: About
pages.content: Hazuki Instruments opened in 2009 at 14 Calder Lane, Wellmouth, with one belief: an instrument purchase should be a fitting, not a sale.

pages.title: Visit
pages.content: 14 Calder Lane, Wellmouth. Open Tuesday to Sunday 11:00–20:00, closed Monday. Phone +1 555 0142.
